card.problem: Teams read long tender documents and want a faster summary before deciding what to do next.
card.user: Any employee who occasionally opens a procurement notice and wants a short explanation.
card.experience: A chat box accepts pasted text and returns a paragraph summary plus a generic recommendation.
card.mechanism: One prompt sends the source text to a general model and displays the response without structured state.
card.required_technology: A database stores chat messages, but the product could work the same way without its named platform.
card.business_case: Users may save reading time, although the buyer, adoption path, and measurable operational value are unclear.
card.build_scope: A single-page chat prototype with one prompt, one response, and no persistence or workflow integration.
card.proof_plan: Paste a notice, show the generated summary, and state that future versions could add qualification and drafting.

card.problem: Bid teams waste time on opportunities that fail mandatory requirements or exceed delivery capacity.
card.user: A bid manager who needs a repeatable qualification checklist before starting a proposal.
card.experience: A dashboard shows eligibility, capacity, margin, a pursue recommendation, and a list of missing inputs.
card.mechanism: Structured tender fields and a supplier profile feed deterministic gates and save a decision record.
card.required_technology: A cloud warehouse stores tenders and decisions, while warehouse code evaluates the qualification policy.
card.business_case: The tool can reduce obvious no-bid effort, but it stops before strategy, proposal writing, or owned remediation.
card.build_scope: A working qualification dashboard, warehouse schema, policy function, fixtures, and saved decision history.
card.proof_plan: Run two suppliers through one tender, show different decisions, and query the saved decision table.
inferences: Useful as a proposal front door

card.problem: Small bid teams must convert complex notices and scattered company evidence into a defensible pursuit and proposal under severe time pressure.
card.user: A B2G proposal team that needs qualification, strategy, drafting, review, ownership, and replay in one operating surface.
card.experience: One room shows the decision, weighted score map, selected strategy, evidence-linked sections, review findings, tasks, and authenticated run trace.
card.mechanism: A versioned opportunity graph drives deterministic policy and an agent writes every downstream artifact under one complete, replayable run.
card.required_technology: The data cloud supplies shared memory, governed computation, agent execution, query provenance, and durable multi-step state that a chat transcript cannot provide.
card.business_case: The product reduces wasted pursuits and proposal coordination while accumulating reusable delivery evidence and institutional bidding memory.
card.build_scope: A polished responsive application, authenticated warehouse integration, agent execution, proposal editor, review loop, tests, and submission assets.
card.proof_plan: Show a two-by-two tender and supplier matrix, generate one complete run, expose a review failure and recovery, then reload the exact run and tasks.
inferences: Can become a paid operating system
